title: requires Examples
concept: Common patterns for requires clauses: non-null checks, bounds validation, state verification, and argument relationships.
why: Learning the common patterns makes writing contracts natural. These patterns cover 90% of real-world precondition needs.
tips: Group related requires clauses together — they become a readable spec
The most common error: forgetting to check that an index is non-negative AND less than length
Write requires BEFORE implementing the body — it clarifies your thinking about edge cases
common_mistakes: Only checking index < len() but forgetting index >= 0
Writing requires: v.len() > 0 but calling v[0] on a separate reference
Making requires too strict — the contract should allow all valid inputs
